meaning:
ὄψις, -εως, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for מַרְאֶה ;]
1. the act of seeing, the sense of sight.
2. face, countenance: Jhn.11:44, Rev.1:16.
3. appear­ance: κατ᾽ ὄ. κρίνειν (see MM, xviii), Jhn.7:24.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”
He had seven stars in his right hand. Out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.
